scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run prisma:push
scripts.sync: npm --prefix ./api-gateway-service i && npm --prefix ./order-catalog-service i && npm --prefix ./inventory-service i && npm --prefix ./payment-service i && npm --prefix ./frontend i
scripts.prisma:push: npm --prefix ./order-catalog-service run prisma:push && npm --prefix ./inventory-service run prisma:push && npm --prefix ./payment-service run prisma:push
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm --prefix ./order-catalog-service run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix ./inventory-service run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix ./payment-service run prisma:deploy
scripts.dev:local: npm run up && npm run ports:free && concurrently -k -n api,order,inv,pay,front -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue "npm --prefix ./api-gateway-service run dev:local" "npm --prefix ./order-catalog-service run dev:local" "npm --prefix ./inventory-service run dev:local" "npm --prefix ./payment-service run dev:local" "npm --prefix ./frontend run dev:local"
